name: Sawara Miho
source:
The Big Sister Type School Queen.

Saint Merhata Academy, Class H, Year 3. Belongs to the Broadcasting Club and serves as its president. She acts as a caring big sister figure to those around her.

Her pleasant, beautiful voice and elegant features are highly valued, often leading to her being called upon for school announcements, modeling work, and hosting events.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
